steps.title: PROHIBITORY SIGNS
steps.lead: Think: something is forbidden or closed.

steps.title: MANDATORY SIGNS
steps.lead: Think: an action or direction must be followed.

steps.title: RESTRICTIVE SIGNS
steps.lead: Think: a limit applies to the waterway or your vessel.

steps.title: RECOMMENDATORY SIGNS
steps.lead: Think: the indicated route or conduct is recommended.

steps.title: INFORMATIVE SIGNS
steps.lead: Think: useful information about the waterway or facility.

steps.title: AUXILIARY INFORMATION
steps.lead: Read the main sign together with its panel, arrow, distance or qualifier.

steps.title: FAIRWAY & WATERWAY MARKING
steps.lead: Use colour, shape, topmark and position together to understand the navigable waterway.

steps.title: SIGNS IN CONTEXT
steps.lead: Recognition is only the first step: apply the sign to the actual passage, opening or fairway.
